response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length, b.avg_length AS baseline_length FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ra.avg_length > b.avg_length), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM above_baseline), remaining AS (SELECT ab.avg_length, ab.baseline_length, km.avg_length AS kept_mean_length FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE ab.avg_length > km.avg_length) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_remaining_rating_avg_length, AVG(avg_length - baseline_length) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(avg_length - kept_mean_length) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM remaining

assumptions.assumption: A rating with no non-NULL film lengths is excluded; the overall baseline likewise averages only non-NULL lengths, as requested.
